description: This file defines the SearchFragment class for an Android app, enabling search functionality for recipes by ingredient keywords. It manages the UI components, binds data from a ViewModel, and handles navigation on recipe selection.

classes.name: SearchFragment
classes.description: A Fragment that provides search functionality for recipes, displaying filtered results in a grid and enabling navigation to recipe details.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes UI components, sets up RecyclerView and input listener, and observes ViewModel results.
